title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> SoundDevices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording of an average‑but‑memorable 1982 show that sounds clear despite the venue’s challenges.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the concert surprisingly well for a difficult acoustic space, delivering a decent audience sound that fans find enjoyable. While reviewers note the performance isn’t one of the Dead’s all‑time best, it holds personal significance and provides a good listening experience overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average to good (≈3.5/5) while recording quality is praised as good/excellent (≈4.5/5). Weighted averaging yields ~3.9 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear the band despite a notoriously tough venue; captures the performance well with no major drop‑outs or muffling reported.
